title: 第23章 无论代价第24章 星火燎原
lines: 卡拉斯化作的流光撞入混沌漩涡核心，如同穿透一层冰冷粘稠的恶意凝胶。
瞬息间，他仿佛被投入沸腾的黑暗熔炉。
混沌能量从四面八方挤压侵蚀星辉之躯。
蛛网裂痕中，黑气如活物钻入，带来灵魂层面的剧痛与混乱低语的直接冲击：“放弃…抵抗…回归…虚无…”
星辉之躯的光芒在重压下急剧黯淡，表面的淡金秩序纹路如风中残烛。
卡拉斯的意志却如嵌入玉石的钢铁，在狂潮中岿然不动。
他无视侵蚀的痛苦，灵魂链接如烧红的烙铁，死死锚定着漩涡中心那扭曲的巨兽——暗爪。
混沌巨兽因对轰余波陷入短暂混乱，头颅甩动，无声咆哮搅动粘稠能量。
卡拉斯抓住这稍纵即逝的时机。
他不再外围对抗，驱动星辉之躯如精准钻头，顺着灵魂链接最强烈的牵引，向巨龙心脏位置——直觉告诉他，那是暗爪残存意识的最后堡垒，也是混沌力量的核心节点——发起决死冲锋！
混沌巨兽内部并非血肉之躯，而是狂暴能量流构成的迷宫。
粘稠黑暗物质形成扭曲腔壁，浮现不断生灭的符文与幻象碎片：索兰尼亚骑士团最后的血色黄昏，净化尖塔焚烧的惨叫，格罗兹狞笑的龙瞳，独眼船长被黑泥吞噬的瞬间…它们如毒刺，试图扎入卡拉斯心防，勾起绝望与悔恨。
“看吧…你的守护…皆是徒劳…秩序…谎言…”
混沌低语在腔壁回荡。
“闭嘴！”
卡拉斯在心中怒吼。
星辉之躯光芒再次凝聚，秩序光刃再现，不再是巨大长矛，而是压缩到极致的尺许长刺目光锥。
他挥动光锥，刺入涌来的粘稠黑暗。
如热铁投入油脂，黑暗物质发出刺耳尖啸，被光锥切割蒸发。
星辉之躯顶着巨大阻力，在混沌巨兽体内一寸寸前进。
每进一步，裂痕中黑气更盛，星辉更弱。
象牙白躯壳上，淡金纹路与黑气交锋，形成不断蔓延的灰败斑痕。
不知穿行多久——时间在此毫无意义。
前方黑暗陡然凝结成黑曜石般、内部涌动能量流的巨大屏障。
屏障中心，一个纯粹混沌能量构成的漩涡缓缓旋转，散发心悸吸力。
漩涡中心，一点极其微弱却顽强闪烁的幽绿星芒，如风中残烛，被狂暴混沌之力撕扯吞噬。
暗爪的意识核心！
星辉之躯猛停于屏障前，光锥光芒在屏障威压下摇曳。
卡拉斯的灵魂烙印感受到前所未有的剧痛——那是暗爪残存意识正被彻底磨灭的痛苦，通过链接直接传来。
“太迟了…秩序碎片…它…属于混沌…”
混沌意志的轰鸣带着嘲弄。
卡拉斯冰冷目光锁定那点微弱星芒。
他看到了！
幽绿星芒最深处，并非混沌的混乱色彩，而是属于暗爪幼生期那纯粹、带着懵懂野性的光芒！
虽微弱，未曾熄灭！
希望如星火，在他冰冷意志中点燃。
他低头看了一眼紧握的青铜龙逆鳞。
这布满裂痕的鳞片冰冷沉寂，但它代表的守护意志，已融入他的灵魂。
他不再需要它的外力，他自己，就是最后的壁垒！
卡拉斯的声音通过灵魂链接，如冰冷誓言穿透混沌轰鸣，直刺那点微弱星芒，“它属于自己！
也属于我！”
content_en:
The stream of light transformed by Karas crashed into the core of the chaotic vortex, like penetrating a layer of cold and sticky malicious gel.
In an instant, he seemed to be plunged into a boiling furnace of darkness.
Chaos energy squeezes and corrodes Xinghui's body from all directions.
In the cracks in the spider web, black energy penetrated like a living thing, bringing severe pain at the soul level and a direct impact of chaotic whispers: "Give up...resist...return...to nothingness..."
The light of the star body dimmed sharply under the heavy pressure, and the light golden order lines on the surface were like candles in the wind.
Karas's will is like steel embedded in jade, unmoving in the frenzy.
He ignored the pain of erosion, and his soul connection was like a red-hot iron, firmly anchoring the twisted giant beast in the center of the vortex - Dark Claw.
The chaotic beast fell into brief chaos due to the aftermath of the bombardment, its head shook, and its silent roar stirred up the viscous energy.
Karas seized this fleeting opportunity.
He no longer fights on the outside, drives his body of starlight like a precise drill, follows the strongest pull of the soul link, and launches a desperate charge towards the dragon's heart - which his intuition tells him is the last bastion of Dark Claw's remaining consciousness and the core node of the power of chaos -!
The interior of the chaos beast is not a body of flesh and blood, but a maze composed of violent energy flows.
The viscous dark matter forms the twisted cavity wall, and the runes and illusion fragments that are constantly emerging and dying emerge: the last bloody dusk of the Solamnian Knights, the screams of the burning purification spire, Groz's dragon eyes with a ferocious smile, the moment when the one-eyed captain is swallowed by the black mud... They are like poisonous thorns, trying to penetrate Karas's heart, arousing despair and regret.
"See...your protection...is all in vain...order...lies..."
Whispers of chaos echoed from the walls of the cavity.
"Shut up!"
Karas roared in his mind.
The light of the star body condensed again, and the light blade of order reappeared. It was no longer a huge spear, but a piercing cone of light that was compressed to the extreme.
He swung his cone of light, piercing the incoming thick darkness.
"Hiss-"
Like hot iron thrown into grease, the dark matter emits a shrill scream and is cut and evaporated by the light cone.
The body of Starlight resisted huge resistance and advanced inch by inch inside the chaotic beast.
With each step forward, the black energy in the crack becomes stronger and the starlight becomes weaker.
On the ivory white body, light gold lines clash with black air, forming spreading gray stains.
I don’t know how long it will take to travel – time is meaningless here.
The darkness ahead suddenly condensed into a huge obsidian-like barrier with energy flowing inside.
In the center of the barrier, a vortex composed of pure chaotic energy slowly rotates, exuding heart-stopping suction.
In the center of the vortex, an extremely weak but tenaciously flickering green star, like a candle in the wind, was torn apart and swallowed by the violent power of chaos.
The core of Dark Claw's consciousness!
The body of starlight suddenly stopped in front of the barrier, and the light cone of light swayed under the pressure of the barrier.
Karas's soul mark felt unprecedented pain - it was the pain of Dark Claw's remaining consciousness being completely wiped out, transmitted directly through the link.
"It's too late...the fragment of order...it...belongs to Chaos..."
The roar of the will of Chaos is taunting.
Karas' cold eyes locked on the faint starlight.
He saw it!
The deepest part of the green starlight is not the chaotic color of chaos, but the pure, ignorant and wild light that belongs to Dark Claw's infancy!
Although weak, it has not been extinguished!
Hope was like a spark, igniting in his cold will.
He glanced down at the tightly held bronze dragon reverse scale.
The cracked scales were cold and silent, but the protective will it represented had been integrated into his soul.
He no longer needs its external force, he himself is the last barrier!
"No,"
Karas’s voice was connected through the soul, roaring through the chaos like a cold oath, and piercing the faint starlight, “It belongs to me!
Belongs to me too! "
title_en: Chapter 23 No matter the cost Chapter 24 A spark that ignites a prairie fire
